# RenG

Canonical documentation: https://rohittp.com/reng/
KMP setup: https://rohittp.com/reng/kmp.html
Source: https://github.com/rohittp0/RenG
Architecture decisions: https://github.com/rohittp0/RenG/tree/main/docs/adr

Maven coordinate: com.rohittp.reng:kmp
Public Maven repository: https://maven.rohittp.com

Published Kotlin Multiplatform targets:
- android
- iosArm64
- iosSimulatorArm64
- macosArm64
- linuxX64
- linuxArm64

License: Apache-2.0

Releases are immutable and fail closed. Every non-documentation push to main publishes only after
validation; an occupied coordinate, malformed response, or validation failure stops publication rather
than overwriting or skipping a version.

RenG is pre-runtime in Cycle A. It exposes no runtime API and renders nothing.
